python - <<'PY'
import warnings
from marshmallow import Schema, fields, missing
from marshmallow.warnings import RemovedInMarshmallow4Warning
from marshmallow_jsonschema import JSONSchema
with warnings.catch_warnings():
    warnings.simplefilter('error', RemovedInMarshmallow4Warning)
    for cls in (fields.Field, fields.Raw):
        f = cls(load_default=lambda: ['loaded'], dump_default=lambda: ['dumped'])
        assert f.deserialize(missing) == ['loaded']
        assert f.serialize('x', {}) == ['dumped']
        assert f.deserialize('present') == 'present'
        assert f.serialize('x', {'x': 'present'}) == 'present'
        assert f.metadata == {}
        assert 'load_default=' in repr(f) and 'dump_default=' in repr(f)
        assert cls(load_default=None).deserialize(None) is None
        try:
            cls(load_default=0, required=True)
        except ValueError as exc:
            assert 'load_default' in str(exc)
        else:
            raise AssertionError('required field accepted load_default')
        assert cls().deserialize(missing) is missing
        assert cls().serialize('x', {}) is missing
    c = fields.Constant(6, load_default=7, dump_default=8)
    assert c.serialize('x', {}) == c.deserialize(missing) == c.deserialize(99) == 6
    class Child(Schema):
        value = fields.Int()
    class Parent(Schema):
        child = fields.Nested(Child, load_default=lambda: {'value': 2}, dump_default={'value': 3})
        raw = fields.Raw(load_default=4, dump_default=5)
    assert Parent().load({}) == {'child': {'value': 2}, 'raw': 4}
    assert Parent().dump({}) == {'child': {'value': 3}, 'raw': 5}
    assert Parent().load({'child': {'value': '9'}})['child'] == {'value': 9}
    props = JSONSchema().dump(Parent())['definitions']['Parent']['properties']
    assert props['child']['default'] == {'value': 3}
    assert props['raw']['default'] == 5
with warnings.catch_warnings(record=True) as caught:
    warnings.simplefilter('always', RemovedInMarshmallow4Warning)
    f = fields.Field(default=1, missing=2, dump_default=3, load_default=4)
    assert (f.dump_default, f.load_default) == (3, 4)
    assert (f.default, f.missing) == (3, 4)
    f.default, f.missing = 5, 6
    assert f.serialize('x', {}) == 5
    assert f.deserialize(missing) == 6
    f.dump_default, f.load_default = 7, 8
    assert (f.default, f.missing) == (7, 8)
    assert len(caught) == 8
print('New default API, warning-free consumer generation, and legacy alias checks passed.')
PY
